paite: Himahleh ni nanung chiang in hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA' inn omna tang, tang lian tungte hihkip in a-om ding a, mualte tung ah tawisang in a-om ding; huai ah tawisang in a-om ding; huai ah chichihte apai zungzung ding uh.
heading: Toupa'n Lemna A Gamsung Vai Ahawmna / (Isa 2.2-4)
english: But in the latter days, it will happen that the mountain of Yahweh’s temple will be established on the top of the mountains, and it will be exalted above the hills; and peoples will stream to it.

paite: Nam tampite apai ding ua, hong unla, TOUPA tang ah, Jakob' Pathian inn ah i hohtou ding uh; huchi in ama'n alampi tanchinte hon sinsak ding a, alampite ah i pai ding ua, achi ding uh; Zion a kipan dan thu ahong pawt ding a. TOUPA thu bel Jerusalem a kipan in ahong pawt ding hi.
english: Many nations will go and say, “Come! Let’s go up to the mountain of Yahweh, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For the law will go out of Zion, and Yahweh’s word from Jerusalem;

paite: Ama'n chi tampi lak ah vai ahawm ding a, gamlapi a nam hattak leng asal ding; anamsaute uh leilehna mukzum ding in asek ding ua, ateipite uh theikung attanna temkawi ding in asek ding uh; namdang in namdang tung ah namsau alikta kei ding a, kidoudan leng asinsakta kei ding uh.
english: and he will judge between many peoples, and will decide concerning strong nations afar off. They will beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will not lift up sword against nation, neither will they learn war any more.

paite: Michihte agrepgui nuai uah leh atheipi kung nuai uah atu ding ua; kuamah in alausak kei ding uh; Sepaihte' TOUPA kam in agenta ngal a.
english: But every man will sit under his vine and under his fig tree. No one will make them afraid, for the mouth of Yahweh of Armies has spoken.

paite: Mi chih amau pathian min chiat in a-om ding ua, ei leng TOUPA i Pathian min in tangtawn tangtawn in i om ding hi.
english: Indeed all the nations may walk in the name of their gods, but we will walk in the name of Yahweh our God forever and ever.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Huai ni chiang in khebaite ka kaikhawm ding a, delhmang a om leh sukgim a omte ka kaikhawm ding," chi in.
heading: Zion Galdouna Leh Vualzohna
english: “In that day,” says Yahweh, “I will assemble that which is lame, and I will gather that which is driven away, and that which I have afflicted;

paite: Akhosuaksunte ka khosuaksak ding a, gamlapi a delhmang a omte bel nam hattak in ka bawl ding; tuban siah Zion tang ah tangtawn in TOUPA'N atung uah vai ahawmta ding hi.
english: and I will make that which was lame a remnant, and that which was cast far off a strong nation: and Yahweh will reign over them on Mount Zion from then on, even forever.”

paite: Aw nang, ganchinna insang, Zion tanu tenna bitna tang, na kiang ah lalgam masa ahong tung ding; ahi, Jerusalem tanu kiang ngei ah lalgam ahong tung ding hi.
english: You, tower of the flock, the hill of the daughter of Zion, to you it will come. Yes, the former dominion will come, the kingdom of the daughter of Jerusalem.

paite: Bang achia hichi nak kah na hia? Na sung ah kumpipa a-om kei a hia, nang hon gensakpa amangthangta a hia, numei nauvei bang a lunggimna in nang ahon mat?
english: Now why do you cry out aloud? Is there no king in you? Has your counselor perished, that pains have taken hold of you as of a woman in travail?

paite: Aw Zion tanu, numei nauvei suak ding bang in natna thuak in vei in; khopi a kipan in na pawtkhe ding a, gam ah na teng ding a, Babulon tanpha a pai ding na hi ngal a, huai ah hotkhiak in na om ding a, huai ah na melmate khut a kipan TOUPA'N nang ahon hunkhe ding hi.
english: Be in pain, and labor to give birth, daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail; for now you will go out of the city, and will dwell in the field, and will come even to Babylon. There you will be rescued. There Yahweh will redeem you from the hand of your enemies.

paite: Tu in tampi nang hon dou in akikhawm ua, hihbuai in om henla, i mit in Zion tung a alunggulhpen mu hen, achi uhi.
english: Now many nations have assembled against you, that say, “Let her be defiled, and let our eye gloat over Zion.”

paite: Himahleh TOUPA ngaihtuahnate athei kei ua, aphatsakna leng atheisiam sam kei uh; phual a buhphal koihkhawm bang in amau akaikhawmta ngal a.
english: But they don’t know the thoughts of Yahweh, neither do they understand his counsel; for he has gathered them like the sheaves to the threshing floor.

paite: Aw Zion tanu, thou inla chil in; sik bang in na kii ka bawl ding a, dal bang in na khepek ka bawl ding; huan mi tampite na satnen ding a; athil neihte uh TOUPA a dia na koihtuam ding ahi, asum uh lei kumpi TOUPA a ding in akoihtuam ding uhi.
english: Arise and thresh, daughter of Zion, for I will make your horn iron, and I will make your hoofs bronze. You will beat in pieces many peoples. I will devote their gain to Yahweh, and their substance to the Lord of the whole earth.
